rule: Webhook events are dispatched through call_event (saleor.core.utils.events, or the BaseMutation.call_event wrapper) and never by calling the plugin-manager event method directly, so the event fires on_commit.
naive: Calls manager.gift_card_updated(gift_card) directly in the new mutation instead of through call_event.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/giftcard/mutations/gift_card_update.py, GiftCardUpdate.perform_mutation now calls manager.gift_card_updated(instance) directly instead of cls.call_event(manager.gift_card_updated, instance). This is the mutation that today changes a gift card's expiry date and sends the gift-card-updated event.
